newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Zako Cyprus H1 pre-tax gains up 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zako Cyprus H1 pre-tax gains up 18 pct.

text.p: Six-month results until June 30 (in millions of Cyprus pounds)
NOTE: Zako, a cosmetics and accessories chain, attributed the drop in turnover to less demand from Cypriot manufacturing industries (mainly clothing) for their products.

A company announcement said that during the period under review the group invested significant sums to renovate its existing outlets and made preparations for the opening of two shops of Next PLC on the island.
In late February public company F.W. Woolworth bought 55.2 percent of Zako. Last month Zako's board accepted a Woolworth bid to take over the remaining 44.8 percent of shares.
